name: WebP Converter
summary: Convert between WebP, PNG, and JPEG with quality control — all client-side.
description: Upload PNG, JPEG, or WebP, pick an output format, set quality for lossy formats, and download the result. Transparency can be filled when exporting to JPEG. Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: Does every browser encode WebP?
faqs.answer: Modern Chromium, Firefox, and Safari do. If encoding fails, try another format or update your browser.

faqs.question: What about transparent PNGs to JPEG?
faqs.answer: JPEG has no alpha. Choose a background color to fill transparent pixels.

faqs.question: Is the image uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion stays in your browser.
